log.text: Light Screen up on P1's side
Light Screen ended on P1's side

decisions.rationale: Charizard-Y mega cancels Drizzle turn 1, neutering Swift Swim Swampert and boosting Sun-empowered Heat Wave/Solar Beam. Whimsicott pressures Water types with Energy Ball and can Encore once Farigiraf falls. Archaludon tanks hits and fires Thunderbolt into Pelipper; Grimmsnarl sets Light Screen with Prankster and punishes Gholdengo with Foul Play (unaffected by Intimidate).
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent runs Pelipper/Swampert-Mega rain + Incineroar/Gholdengo/Klefki/Farigiraf. Key interactions: Charizard-Y sun cancels Drizzle; Gholdengo immune to all status (Good as Gold) so only damage works vs it; Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks Prankster while active - must KO or force it out before relying on Whimsicott/Grimmsnarl priority; Foul Play uses foe's Attack so Intimidate doesn't weaken it vs Gholdengo; Electro Shot fires without charging in Rain but requires charge turn in Sun. Plan: Mega Charizard-Y immediately to cancel rain, use Sun-boosted Fire moves and Solar Beam for Water types. Bring Grimmsnarl for Foul Play vs Gholdengo and Light Screen support once Farigiraf is removed.

Mega Charizard-Y activates Drought before Swampert-Mega can benefit from Swift Swim (167 Spe > 65-112 raw), canceling rain and removing the speed boost. Double super-effective Grass (Solar Beam 91-255% + Energy Ball 83-232%) likely KOes Swampert before it can Rock Slide or Waterfall. Removes the primary win condition and establishes Sun for follow-up.

Swampert must Protect; Mega Evolving simultaneously banks the Attack boost and keeps Swift Swim available if Rain is re-established later. Pelipper Hydro Pumps Charizard (2x SE, 88% acc w/ Wide Lens, 20–106%) to chip or KO the Sun setter before it dominates. Hurricane on Whimsicott is 55% in Sun—unreliable. Wide Guard fails vs Solar Beam. This is the safest line that still
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Charizard-Mega-Y (Drought, Timid, 115–167 Spe), Whimsicott (Prankster, Focus Sash, Timid, 133–184 Spe), Ampharos (Plus, Modest, 60–107), Grimmsnarl (Prankster, LightClay, Impish, 65–112), Quaquaval (Moxie, LifeOrb, Jolly, 99–150), Archaludon (Sturdy, WiseGlasses, Modest, 90–137). Key interaction: Charizard-Mega-Y Drought overrides Pelipper Drizzle Rain at turn start, disabling Swampert-Mega Swift Swim speed boost. To re-enable Swift Swim, must switch Pelipper out and back in (Drizzle re-triggers) after Drought Sun expires (5 turns). Swampert-Mega Protect+Mega on T1 banks stats. Plan: survive T1, chip Charizard, look to re-establish Rain via Pelipper pivot for Swift Swim sweep. Incineroar Intimidate + Fake Out for speed control next turns. Gholdengo Good as Gold immune to Prankster status (Taunt/Encore/TWave) — strong switch-in vs Whimsicott/Grimmsnarl.

decisions.rationale: Double target Swampert-Mega with 4x super effective Grass moves. Swampert's Protect rate is reduced after turn 1, making success less likely. KOing Swampert removes the Rock Slide threat (4x to Charizard) and secures board control. Pelipper's moves have low accuracy, so the risk of taking damage is manageable.

Swampert is outsped and guaranteed KO'd by 4x Solar Beam — must switch. Incineroar resists both Grass and Fire, safest switch-in vs Charizard's sun-boosted moves. Pelipper takes only neutral/NVE from everything, so it stays to chip Whimsicott with 2x SE Hurricane (77% w/ Wide Lens). Encore risk locks Pelipper into Hydro Pump (neutral on Charizard in sun) — manageable. Next turn: Incineroar Fake Out + Pelipper attack/pivot.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Charizard-Mega-Y (Drought, Timid, 115–167 Spe), Whimsicott (Prankster, FocusSash, Timid, 133–184 Spe), Ampharos (Plus, Modest, 60–107), Grimmsnarl (Prankster, LightClay, Impish, 65–112), Quaquaval (Moxie, LifeOrb, Jolly, 99–150), Archaludon (Sturdy, WiseGlasses, Modest, 90–137). Key: Charizard-Mega-Y Drought overrides Pelipper Drizzle; Swift Swim disabled under Sun. Sun has 4 turns left (T2). To re-enable Swift Swim: switch Pelipper out and back in after Sun expires to re-trigger Drizzle Rain. Incineroar is the safest switch-in vs Charizard sun team (resists Grass 0.5x and Fire 0.5x). Gholdengo resists Grass but is 2x weak to Fire — risky switch-in while Sun is active (Heat Wave 66–239% range). Gholdengo immune to Prankster status (Encore/Taunt/TWave) — best switch-in vs Whimsicott/Grimmsnarl when Fire threat is absent. Whimsicott Encore outprioritizes all of Pelipper's moves (+1 vs +0/+3/+4); Encore locks into last used move. Plan: survive Sun turns with Incineroar/Gholdengo, chip Whimsicott (break Sash), then re-establish Rain via Pelipper pivot for Swift Swim Swampert sweep. Pelipper takes neutral/NVE from all of Charizard+Whimsicott's moves — safe to keep active under Sun.

decisions.rationale: Whimsicott at 1% HP is a sitting duck to priority Fake Out and any spread hit. Protect keeps Charizard safe while Grimmsnarl enters at full HP to set Light Screen with Prankster priority and threaten Foul Play. This preserves momentum and brings the correct follow-up piece for the matchup.

Fake Out at +3 priority KOs Whimsicott (1% HP, 100% acc) before its Prankster Encore can fire, eliminating disruption. Hydro Pump hits Charizard for 2x SE (30–80% even under Sun-halved Water). If Charizard Protects or Hydro misses, we still remove Whimsicott for a clean 2v1. Pelipper survives Solar Beam (39–72%) and stays healthy enough to re-establish Rain later.

decisions.rationale: Solar Beam OHKOs Pelipper up to 140% in Sun, removing rain threat permanently. Light Screen from Prankster Grimmsnarl sets up before most moves, reducing Hydro Pump and special damage next turns. Even if Incineroar Fake Out flinches Grimmsnarl, Charizard still pressures Pelipper heavily.

Pelipper must survive 2 more Sun turns to re-trigger Drizzle for Swift Swim Swampert. Protect blocks Solar Beam (+4 over Prankster Taunt +1). Incineroar Parting Shot lowers Zard SpA so next-turn Solar Beam is weaker, then pivots to Gholdengo (immune to Prankster Taunt). Aggressive Hydro Pump risks Pelipper KO before it moves since Zard is faster.

decisions.rationale: Heat Wave with Sun boost and STAB can OHKO Gholdengo even at -1 SpA (85-239%). Foul Play finishes if it survives (50-136%). Combined KO chance is high. Charizard outspeeds both foes, so it moves first. Hydro Pump has 80% accuracy and isn't guaranteed to KO Charizard. Removing Gholdengo eliminates Make It Rain threat and opens up future plays.

Sun expires end of turn. Switching Pelipper to Incineroar preserves Pelipper at 100% for immediate Drizzle re-trigger next turn (Incineroar→Pelipper), saving a full switch cycle vs staying in. Incineroar resists Solar Beam and Heat Wave 0.5x, surviving easily from 74%. Gholdengo Protects to dodge Foul Play (60-128% possible OHKO). Next turn: bring Pelipper in for Rain, then Swampert-Mega Swift Swim sweep at 180 Spe outspeeding everything.

Win condition: Re-establish Rain via Pelipper Drizzle (switch out under Sun, back in after Sun expires) → Swampert-Mega Swift Swim (90→180 Spe) outspeeds entire opponent team including Charizard 115-167. Swampert Rock Slide 4x SE on Charizard; Earthquake hits Grimmsnarl/Ampharos/Archaludon SE.

Key preservation rules: Swampert-Mega must stay off field until Rain is active (4x Solar Beam weak under Sun). Gholdengo is primary Charizard check under Sun (resists Solar Beam 0.5x, immune to Prankster status via Good as Gold, has Recover+Leftovers). Incineroar is safe switch-in vs Charizard sun (resists Grass 0.5x + Fire 0.5x) but watch for Taunt locking out Parting Shot/Protect.

Damage refs (tool, pre-boost): Solar Beam on Pelipper 50-104% (neutral, ~33-70% at SpA-1). Foul Play on Gholdengo 60-128% SE. Heat Wave on Gholdengo 92-184% SE (~62-123% at SpA-1, spread). Hydro Pump on Charizard under Sun+Light Screen ≈ 0.5x — not worth using.

decisions.rationale: Charizard outspeeds Gholdengo (167 vs 89-136). Heat Wave is SE vs Gholdengo (56-159%) and hits both foes. Foul Play is also SE (49-136%). Combined damage likely KO's Gholdengo before it can Make It Rain. Incineroar at 59% HP is pressured by Heat Wave. Gholdengo's Protect success is reduced, making KO more likely. Removing Gholdengo eliminates the biggest threat to Grimmsnarl and opens up future plays.
